description: Core concepts of process control, concurrency primitives, memory management, and deadlock handling.

subtopics.name: Process Synchronization & Semaphores
subtopics.description: Critical sections, Mutex locks, Counting Semaphores, and Peterson's Algorithm.

subtopics.name: Deadlocks & Banker's Algorithm
subtopics.description: 4 Coffman conditions, deadlock prevention, detection, and resource allocation graphs.

subtopics.name: Virtual Memory & Paging
subtopics.description: Page tables, Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB), Page Faults, and replacement policies (LRU, FIFO).

description: Fundamental and advanced non-linear data structures, balanced trees, graph traversals, and hash tables.

subtopics.name: Trees & Self-Balancing BSTs
subtopics.description: AVL Trees, Red-Black Trees balancing rotations, B-Trees, and Trie structures.

subtopics.name: Graph Algorithms & Shortest Path
subtopics.description: Dijkstra's Algorithm, Bellman-Ford, BFS/DFS traversals, and Minimum Spanning Trees (Kruskal/Prim).

subtopics.name: Hashing & Collision Resolution
subtopics.description: Hash functions, Separate Chaining, Open Addressing (Linear/Quadratic Probing, Double Hashing).

description: Relational data modeling, normal forms, transaction ACID guarantees, and database index structures.

subtopics.name: Database Normalization (1NF to BCNF)
subtopics.description: Functional dependencies, candidate keys, loss-less join decomposition, and 3NF vs BCNF.

subtopics.name: Transactions & ACID Concurrency
subtopics.description: Two-Phase Locking (2PL), Serializability, Isolation levels, and Write-Ahead Logging (WAL).

subtopics.name: B+ Tree Indexing & Query Processing
subtopics.description: Clustered vs Non-clustered indexing, B+ Tree search operations, and cost-based query execution.

description: Layered protocol stack, TCP/IP fundamentals, IP routing algorithms, and network subnetting.

subtopics.name: TCP/IP Protocol Suite & 3-Way Handshake
subtopics.description: SYN/ACK connection establishment, TCP flow control (Sliding Window), and congestion control.

subtopics.name: IP Routing Protocols & Algorithms
subtopics.description: Distance Vector (RIP), Link State (OSPF), BGP path vector, and packet forwarding tables.
